prs.title: research: archive unmerged Claude lane branches from 2026-10-27
prs.body:
This archives the research that twelve Claude lane branches pushed on 2026-10-27 and never merged, so those branches can be deleted. It's part of a review of every remote branch.

- Everything goes under `research/claude-lane-branch-archive-20261028/<branch>/`, plus an `inventory.json` listing each head SHA, the merge base and the blob ids.
- It's all additions (379 files, about 91 MB, none over 5 MB). No existing file changes, and nothing outside `research/` is touched.
- No file is copied into an existing packet. mayhem-a's packet is sealed by `manifest.json`, and `amm-event-capture-*` pins three `claude-amm-mid` files; copying into either would break them.
- Lane edits to `programs/` are left out, because main's current sources supersede them.
- Before archiving, I ran the lane verifiers on a materialized tree with `python -I -B` and an empty HOME. amm-mid, mayhem-b, pump-lo, pump-mid and pump-mid-mayhem-o0084 passed. mayhem-a failed only its seal check, which is why this uses a separate archive root.

I coordinated with the owner of #403 and the Mayhem session. The Mayhem session asked to keep the `mayhem-o79` and `pump-mid-20261027-latest` branches until its r436 lanes are done with them.

prs.title: Research: recover PumpSwap fee helper source coordinates
prs.body:
## Summary

- recover the original source-line layout for the complete PumpSwap `ceil_div`
  (`0x12b08`, 1,672 bytes) and `fee` (`0x13190`, 712 bytes) windows;
- retain a research-only verification packet with source identity, selected
  checkpoint diagnostics, complete 785-window census logic, direct-call checks,
  hashes, and qualification limits;
- leave the maintained PumpSwap checkpoint and its published **656/785
  normalized / 148 raw** metrics unchanged.

The source edit is whitespace-only. Both parent and proposal reduce to the same
whitespace-stripped SHA-256:
`cccc7b0c28e63a44592f58ea0965457350ae796053bf7c5eec0a63728bc09868`.
No formatter was run over the recovered layout.

## Evidence

The actual selected checkpoint is
`repro/pump_amm/private-sweep-recovery-20261027`, candidate
`9278a52ae4fd93bb6159a72fa625f121394902a93f701d86931a7ec3778055fb`.
Its complete inventory was recomputed as **656 normalized, 148 raw, 129
unmatched out of 785**.

Before this proposal, its only normalized differences in the two target windows
are three source-line immediates:

- `ceil_div` original `0x12b08` -> candidate `0x226a0`: `18 -> 19` at
  `+0x278`, and `19 -> 21` at `+0x630`;
- `fee` original `0x13190` -> candidate `0x22d28`: `25 -> 32` at `+0x248`.

The proposed operations are on lines 19, 21, and 32. All 17 direct-call
positions resolve: 16 targets are already normalized pairs, and `fee +0x70`
resolves exactly to proposed `ceil_div` (`0x22d28 + 0x70 -> 0x226a0`).

A separately measured Darwin arm64 v1.44 cohort produced:

| | Baseline | Proposal |
|---|---:|---:|
| normalized matches | 651 | 653 |
| raw matches | 139 | 139 |

New normalized windows were exactly `0x12b08` and `0x13190` (2,384 text
bytes); there were no normalized or raw losses. Both complete windows had zero
normalized instruction differences, matching relocation shape, and aligned
11/11 and 6/6 direct calls. The exact unstripped hashes are retained in
`result.json`; whole-ELF and raw equality are false.

## Verification

```sh
python3 -B repro/pump_amm/fee-helper-source-coordinates-20261028/verify.py
git diff --check origin/main...HEAD
```

Verifier result:

```text
source_identity: ok
selected checkpoint inventory: 656 normalized / 148 raw / 785
selected diagnostic witnesses: 3 retained differences verified
selected direct-call targets: 17/17 resolved
maintained checkpoint promoted: false
```

A fresh local v1.44 source build returned 0 (with the checkpoint's existing
`admin_update_token_incentives` stack warning). The currently available
`cargo-build-sbf 4.1.0` launcher produced a different, explicitly retained
negative-control cohort: 638 -> 638 normalized and 139 -> 139 raw, with no
gains or losses. It therefore is not used for promotion.

## Qualification limits

The authenticated Linux driver could not reach compilation on this Darwin arm64
host. Podman, the exact Linux/amd64 v1.44 SDK and authenticated archive, and the
retained logical Cargo/target caches are unavailable. Therefore this PR is a
research-only source proposal, not a maintained-checkpoint rebuild.

No new VM replay is claimed for the proposal: the Rust token stream is
unchanged, but source diagnostics are observable and require the authenticated
build plus the existing offline suites before promotion. No live transaction
was submitted, no historical evidence was edited, and no binaries or generated
caches are added.

Open PR #408 recovers a different `transfer_fee` caller and does not touch
`programs/pump-amm/src/curve/fees.rs` or this research packet.

prs.title: Recover complete AMM fee caller with a native value copy (732 to 733)
prs.body:
The original AMM `calculate_fee` caller copies its 24-byte fee payload into a local value before calling the native method. The current source borrows that payload directly and emits640 bytes. Changing **`match data` to `match *data`** restores the original 696-byte/80-instruction function at 0x74648.

On the same normal full-contract recipe this is **732 -> 733/785 normalized functions**, with all 148 raw matches retained and no losses. The newly matched caller actually calls the previously recovered 368-byte method from merged #405. Five real direct callee bodies and all seven typed root references agree, including six vtable methods and the Source filename/line 49/error 6023. Incoming graphs and transitive data are not claimed identical.

Validation:
- One changed file among 54 inputs; no dependency, lock, arithmetic or compiler-flag changes. Two new normal builds reproduce both whole ELF hashes with 396 dependency artifacts unchanged.
- Qualified MIR/LLVM captures show the local24-byte copy responsible for the original three 8-byte machine copies. Both captures strip to their respective normal binaries; diagnostic outputs are kept separate.
- 2,266 original/732/733 suite triples, 216 fresh-VM triples and 7 targeted error-path triples pass. Actual loader hashes, signatures and full message-account snapshots are retained. Existing buy/sell log differences remain 76/88. The additional synthetic invalid-fee fixture reaches the recovered wrapper's Overflow 6023 atline 49, with identical errors and rollback; six epoch controls overlap the larger matrix.
- Local packet verification recomputes source bindings, body/call/data evidence and signed receipts. A dedicated CI audit is added.

Review `research/amm-fee-value-call-recovery/source.patch` and README. The baseline is the actual retained 732 source/artifact from #405; previous results are not relabeled. The maintained checkpoint stays separate pending integration. Whole-ELF/raw target identity and exhaustive behavior remain unproved, and inherited unrelated admin stack-frame diagnostics remain in the logs.

prs.title: Trace Mayhem closure overflow-profile loss through LLVM passes
prs.body:
The historical checked price helper and an immediately invoked closure containing the same price-first statements produce different overflow-guard metadata. Actual compiler dumps now locate the difference: the closure's second SimplifyCFGPass removes a redundant profiled test whose empty successors rejoin, leaving a later unprofiled test of the same overflow flag. The helper retains its profiled test through AlwaysInliner; the ordinary inliner imports the closure's already unprofiled test.

This follows #398 and adds `composition/price-profile/` to its existing evidence packet. It also preserves a source ambiguity: the checked closure and the distinct Option-projection source emit identical complete symbols and stripped ELFs despite different CodeGen Prepare IR.

Validation:
- One source-control build and four diagnostic repeats; each trace build reproduces both complete parent ELFs, including nonallocated bytes.
- Exact 67-file source derivation, commands, pinned tools, 104 reused dependency artifacts, full logs, linker captures and output receipts retained.
- Offline parent replay and all 34 tests pass, including five new evidence counterexamples. All 749 packet files equal their committed Git bytes; whitespace check passes.
- Initial CRLF parser failure retained and corrected. No compiler failures, fresh dependency builds or target executions in this increment.

Upstream's newer qualified436 composition already closes both Legacy bodies under normalization. This PR records compiler provenance for the older 432-window controls; it adds no complete-window match and changes no selected source, matcher or checkpoint. It does not diagnose a compiler bug, isolate metadata as the sole cause of final layout, or claim original-source, behavioral or whole-original byte identity.

prs.title: Recover complete AMM native transfer-fee calculation (731 to 732)
prs.body:
The AMM native transfer-fee calculation still used SPL's packed fee representation, producing a 360-byte helper instead of the original 368-byte native function. This source proposal restores the native reference ABI and separate amount-zero/basis-point-zero guards through a small, genuinely used `no_std` path dependency.

On the same normal full-contract recipe, the measured baseline goes **731 -> 732/785 normalized functions**, retaining **all 148 raw matches** with no losses. The new match is the complete 368-byte/46-instruction function at original `0xf2d60`. Both actual direct callees (`__multi3`, `__udivti3`) are raw-identical to their originals; this helper has no data-address references. The containing caller remains unmatched.

The measured base combines merged #388's prepare source and #395's reader source. It does **not** include #381's deposit composition, despite #395 independently reporting the same 731 total. Their prior gains are not claimed here. The decoder is unchanged. The local crate boundary is a reconstruction proposal, not an authenticated historical crate name or source layout.

Validation:
- Two normal full builds and a third replay through the published CLI reproduce both complete ELF hashes; four existing files change and two dependency source files are added. All prior locked package records and 393 dependency artifacts stay unchanged. Same-crate control instead promotes reference arguments to scalars and remains unmatched at376B.
- 2,266 original/baseline/candidate case triples (6,798 signed executions), plus216 fresh-VM triples (648 executions): no new state/return/CPI differences. Existing non-compute buy/sell log differences remain76/88; the focused matrix has none. Actual load hashes, full message-account snapshots, signature verification and failure rollback receipts are retained.
- Local packet verification,9 captured-evidence checks and6 tooling tests pass. The focused matrix includes zero/boundary basis points, caps and amounts, plus inherited decoder/epoch controls. Rejections are classified rather than claimed as helper coverage.

Start at `research/amm-native-transfer-fee-recovery/README.md` and `source.patch`. The packet contains complete source archives, normally built ELFs, portable materialize/rebuild entry points, compiler/failed-control evidence and a CI receipt audit. It keeps the maintained checkpoint unchanged pending integration. No whole-ELF/raw target equality, exhaustive behavior, transitive closure or historical build provenance is claimed. Existing unrelated admin stack-frame diagnostics remain in build logs.

prs.title: Mayhem: close O0081 + O0082 (436/441, no losses)
prs.body:
## Summary
This PR adds the packet `research/claude-mayhem-436-20261027/`. It closes Mayhem windows **O0081** (Legacy Buy, 13,848 B) and **O0082** (Legacy Sell, 12,992 B) on top of the 434/441 tree that #397 shipped on main. Lane pl-o82 found the closures. The packet rebuilds them clean, re-measures them, and reruns both runtime suites on the clean ELF.

- **Source:** ordinary Rust in six files (`source.patch`): pump_interface.rs, state.rs, buy_v2.rs, pump_interface_v2.rs, buy_pump_swap.rs, sell_pump_swap.rs. There is no asm, padding, patched bytes or unused ops.
  - Shared helpers take the bonding curve and the cap by reference.
  - The price checks use `let … else` / `checked_div`.
  - The CPI signer seeds are built inline.
  - `token_program` is cloned before `creator_vault`.
  - `SellEvent` is declared in its serialized order with `side: bool`, and its literal order matches the original.
- **Builds:** two clean builds (fresh target dirs, anchor re-cleaned) were identical: stripped `e93b60f1001c5bc6…`, symbols `49d70dc773147690…`. Neither printed a stack-offset warning.
- **Measure** (`measure.py`, against parent-434 `828751f9`):
  - 434 -> **436/441**, with gains exactly `[O0081, O0082]`.
  - **No losses:** body, raw, profile, edge and Source are all clean. Raw-local stays at 100, edges go 4370 -> 4472, Source 470 -> 484.
  - Against cp4 (433), the gains are `[O0073, O0081, O0082]`, also with no losses.
- **Runtime** (both run on the clean stripped ELF):
  - Stock sweep suite: 692 cases, 0 mismatches. Logs are equal to the original (mod CU), and the results are identical to the parent-434 receipt.
  - Trade suites: 14 families, 6,636 cases, 0 mismatches, 0 non-compute log differences.
- **Remaining unmatched windows:** O0076, O0077, O0079, O0083, O0084.
- `PROGRESS.md` documents the edits and pl-o82's ablations. Each O0082 hunk turns out to be necessary on its own, and the hunks also need the O0081 helper layer.
- **CI:** a new suite, `mayhem-436-o0081-o0082`, runs the packet's verify.py.

## Test plan
- [x] `HOME=$(mktemp -d) python3 -B research/claude-mayhem-436-20261027/verify.py` passes all 82 checks, including the cross-check of the parent-434 inventory against main's cp4 source-inputs plus the #397 fee_recipients.rs.
- [ ] CI suite `mayhem-436-o0081-o0082`

prs.title: research(pump-big-lo): three verified main-Pump window gains on g04 (806 → 809)
prs.body:
Adds the `pump-big-lo` lane packet. The lane branch `claude/pump-big-lo-20261027` was pushed at 67a1705f8 but never got a PR, and none of these gains is in main or in #401.

**Gains on the g04 genuine composite (806 / 165 → 809 normalized, no losses; L06 899 → 902):**

| window | handler | packet |
|---|---|---|
| 0x38fc0 | `set_creator` (6,136 B) | `gain01-set_creator/` |
| 0x3a7b8 | `set_metaplex_creator` (3,552 B) | `gain01-set_creator/` |
| 0x746a8 | `admin_update_token_incentives` (3,168 B) | `gain02-incentives/` |

The source rule behind them: in `emit_cpi!` handlers, the original's error path loads the data pointer first. That happens when the source has no `event.clone()` and the event's scope contains an explicit `return Ok(())`. The rule only applies to some windows: applying it to every handler lost 9 windows. `tools/errpath.py` lists the 18 data-first sites in the original.

**Also included:** `body-only/0x37e08-migrate_bonding_curve_creator.patch`. With it, the whole body matches except the two Source line immediates, which are left to the layout integrator.

### Verification (run locally on this branch)
```
HOME=$(mktemp -d) python3 -I -B research/claude-pump-big-lo-20261027/gain01-set_creator/verify.py
  verified: 808 / 165 gains ['0x38fc0', '0x3a7b8']
  runtime-corpus44.json: 44 suites, 10468 cases, 0 errors, 0 diagnostic mismatches
HOME=$(mktemp -d) python3 -I -B research/claude-pump-big-lo-20261027/gain02-incentives/verify.py
  verified: 807 / 165 gains ['0x746a8']
  runtime-incentives.json: 2 suites, 909 cases, 0 errors, 0 diagnostic mismatches
```

### Limits
- This is a research packet. It does not change `programs/pump` or the maintained Round38 checkpoint, and whole-ELF identity is still false.
- The two gains were measured separately on g04. The combined 809 figure comes from the lane README and has no runtime run of its own. Integrating them into the next composite is a separate step.
- Some lane tools under `tools/` use absolute paths to the shared work roots, so they document the method rather than run as-is.

prs.title: Fix Round37 curvehop745 materializer parent manifest check
prs.body:
Follow-up to [#342](https://github.com/lalalune/pumpfun-source/pull/342), found while reviewing it.

## Problem

Against the committed Round37 parent, `research/pump-round37-curvehop745/materialize.py` failed every stage with `ValueError: source mismatch: programs/pump/Cargo.toml`. Running `test_materialize.py --parent repro/pump/main-contract-round37-20261027` errored in 92 of 123 tests.

The materializer reads `primary/Cargo.toml` (sha256 `7a1d296c…`) and checks it against the workspace-member pin `93dd3a28…`. The primary copy is the standalone single-crate manifest. It carries a trailing `[profile.release]` / `[workspace]` block that the member manifest omits; the member form is `source/programs/pump/Cargo.toml` in the same package.

On macOS the tests also failed earlier, with `symlink path`, because the default temp directory is under `/var -> /private/var`.

## Fix

- **`materialize.py`:** before the pin check, strip the exact standalone tail. The tail must be present exactly once, otherwise the run is rejected. The result is the pinned member manifest byte for byte, and every other input and pin is unchanged.
- **`test_materialize.py`:** resolve the temp root, so the existing symlink guard sees a real path.

## Verification

- 123/123 tests pass against the committed parent, on macOS with the default temp directory.
- `refund817` was materialized with this fix and built with the v1.44 sbpf identity recipe (Linux target libraries and a hybrid sysroot).
  - It scores **817 / 1,035 normalized windows** with no losses against Round37. This matches #342's normalized claim.
  - Raw is 135 on this macOS hybrid; #342's Linux profile reports 133.
  - No stack-offset warnings.
- Runtime is still NOT RUN, the same as #342.

Only these two research files change.
